item.title: 二阶行列式
item.author: strr0
item.description: 二元线性方程组 $\begin{cases} a_{11}x_{1} + a_{12}x_{2} = b_{1} ①\\ a_{21}x_{1} + a_{22}x_{2} = b_{2} ②\end{cases}$ ① × $a_{22}$ - ② × $a_{12}$得 $x_{1} = \frac{\begin{vmatrix} b_{1} & a_{12} \\ b_{2} & a_{22} \end{vmatrix}}{\begin{vmatrix} a_{11} & a_{12} \\ a_{21} & a_{22} \end{vmatrix}}$ 同理
